- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 733822cf8562d671682794edba717cdd1700b1c0` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8a4cb2f02a101336acf5f10c98897a4c8c18151e`

### ① Derived judgments

Reviewed at head `8a4cb2f02a101336acf5f10c98897a4c8c18151e` (PR #20302, card #20146), merge-base `1207baf0` with `main`, diff exactly 5 files (+94/−41). objectui readers were measured with `git show` / `git grep` against the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb0596f4521076628e2bbfe27e6ce67d52` (the pin at the head) and controlled at objectui `fb91ac9b0c4ae994179afd83ddcf078e0f3fd2c6`; objectui's HEAD was never switched. Gates were run in a detached worktree at the head under the scratchpad (installed from the offline store; `check:*` scripts run outside the heavy-verify lock, as that lock's own header states), and the worktree was removed afterwards.

**1. Every re-pointed row names a real, MOUNTED reader at `f8a9d0fb` — RIGHT.**

Preconditions measured: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSidebar.tsx` exists at the pin and is absent at `fb91ac9b0`. At the pin its only non-test references are the two deprecated barrel exports (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:139`, `layout/index.ts:7`), comments, and one JSX occurrence inside the `providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` doc comment (line 12). No mount site. Every file the 12 rows cite exists at both shas.

Mount chain, measured at the pin: `apps/console/src/App.tsx:389` renders the console `AppContent`, whose line 36 renders app-shell's `DefaultAppContent` (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:263`, the alias of `console/AppContent.tsx#AppContent`) with `extraRoutes={systemRoutes}`; app-shell `AppContent` renders `ConsoleLayout` at line 1028 and `{extraRoutes}` at line 1116; `ConsoleLayout` renders `AppShell` (line 134) with `UnifiedSidebar` as sidebar (136) and `AppHeader` as navbar (142); `AppHeader:488` renders `AppSwitcher`; `UnifiedSidebar:543` and `:673` render `NavigationRenderer`; `App.tsx:127` renders `DefaultHomePage` (= `console/home/HomePage.tsx`, `index.ts:271`), and `HomePage:600` renders `HomeAppsStrip`; `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx:160` routes `system/apps` to `AppManagementPage` inside the exported `systemRoutes` fragment.

Per row, the cited symbol and the read, each confirmed at the pin and identical at `fb91ac9b0`:
- `label`: `AppSwitcher.tsx#AppSwitcher` reads `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(activeApp.label, t)` (51) and `app.label` per row (68); `ConsoleLayout.tsx#ConsoleLayout` reads `activeApp?.label` into `appLabel` (75), hands it to `AppHeader` (144) and into the `AppShell` branding `title` (174–176); `HomeAppsStrip.tsx#HomeAppsStrip` reads `app.label` (127).
- `description`: `apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx#AppManagementPage` (98) takes `apps` from `useMetadata()` (103), renders `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(app.description, t)` per row (457–458) and searches it in `filteredApps` (167–173). Routed and reachable as above. Not counted: `console/home/AppCard.tsx` reads `app.description` but at the pin is only barrel-exported (`console/home/index.ts:10`), no JSX mount anywhere — the row says so.
- `icon`: `AppSwitcher` `getIcon(app.icon)` (67); `HomeAppsStrip` `getIcon(app.icon)` (126).
- `branding.primaryColor` / `accentColor` / `favicon`: `ConsoleLayout` hands exactly `activeApp.branding.primaryColor`, `.accentColor`, `.favicon` (171–173) to `AppShell`'s `branding` prop; `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx#useAppShellBranding` (140) maps `primaryColor` onto `--primary`, `--ring`, `--sidebar-primary` (164–170, with a dark variant), `accentColor` onto `--accent` (192), and sets the `#favicon` link's `href` (221–225); `AppShell` calls the hook (268). `AppShellBranding` (12–25) has no `logo` field.
- `active`: `AppSwitcher:45` `a.active !== false && a.hidden !== true`; `UnifiedSidebar:205` the same filter and `:207` the active-app lookup over the apps filtered on `active !== false` only; `utils/appRoute.ts#filterActiveApps` (86–88), called by `HomePage.tsx:355`, `views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx:119` and `resolveHostAppSegment` (132); `AppHeader.tsx:857` avatar menu `a.active !== false && a.hidden === true && a.name !== 'account'`. Routing claim: app-shell `console/AppContent.tsx:243` `matchAppBySegment(apps, appName)` over all apps — the corrected note is true.
- `hidden`: the same four readers; the `UnifiedSidebar:207` lookup filters on `active` only, so it spans hidden apps as the row says; `AppHeader:857` lists `hidden === true` apps with Account excepted. The in-repo `ACCOUNT_APP` leg resolves locally (gate: 614/614).
- `navigation[].id`: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx#useNavOrder` (74) persists ids per app (maps the reordered items to their `id`s and rebuilds through a `byId` map); `UnifiedSidebar` calls `useNavPins()` (211), whose `hooks/useNavPins.ts` keys favourites by `itemId`; `NavigationRenderer.tsx#NavigationRenderer` (1296): `useSortable({ id: item.id })` (954), `onPinToggle(itemId, …)` (939), `key={item.id}` (1414–1477), `item.id === activeNavId` (1201); `views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx#NavMenuRenderer` (147): `resolveActiveNavItem(...)?.id` (239), `key={item.id}` (273–326).
- `navigation[].visible`: `UnifiedSidebar` `evalVis` (215–216, `evaluateVisibility` from the ExpressionProvider) handed to `NavigationRenderer` (546, 676) and `hasVisibleNavigationItems` (273–274); `NavMenuRenderer` `evalVis` (164) and `if (!evalVis(item.visible)) return null` (266). The unchanged `NavigationRenderer.tsx:891` leg at `@940ba24` corresponds to `evaluateVisibility(item.visible)` at pin line 407.
- `areas[].id` / `label` / `icon` / `navigation`: `UnifiedSidebar` `activeAreaId` state (283), lookup `a.id === activeAreaId` (303), `area.id` key/click (517), `resolveInlineI18nLabel(area.label, language)` (523), `getIcon(area.icon)` (516), `activeArea?.navigation || activeApp?.navigation` (304). The `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx:469` leg is unchanged.
- File `_note`: names UnifiedSidebar / AppSwitcher / AppHeader / ConsoleLayout / ContextSelectors, HomeAppsStrip, NavigationRenderer / AppShell, RootLandingRedirect / AppManagementPage, and records the sha choice. All named readers are mounted per the chain above (ContextSelectors, RootLandingRedirect legs are unchanged rows).

One non-blocking nuance: `NavMenuRenderer` is registered, not statically mounted — `ComponentRegistry.register('menu', NavMenuRenderer)` (370) through the side-effect import `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:345`; no page in the console, app-shell, `packages/platform-objects` or `examples` declares a `menu` component. The two rows that cite it also cite `UnifiedSidebar` / `NavigationRenderer`, which are mounted, so no verdict rests on that leg.

Gate-side: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:objectui-pin-citations` at the head, with the read-only objectui clone reachable as `../objectui`: exit 0, `47 asserting objectui pin citation(s) match .objectui-sha (f8a9d0fb0)`, `7 anchor content assertion(s) verified against objectui at f8a9d0fb0`. `check:liveness` counts the ledger's foreign pointers 202 → 218 with no local path or anchor change (614/614, 758/758), which confirms every new `objectui @f8a9d0fb:` clause is attributed to the foreign realm and none was mis-parsed as a local path (`evidence.mts#scanEvidence`: a realm marker runs to the next `;` or `)`).

**2. `branding.logo` → `planned`, carrier objectui#10827, producer pointers; no `authorWarn` — RIGHT.**

Census at the pin (control: the same grep for `branding.primaryColor` hits `ConsoleLayout:171` and `AppShell.tsx:152–167`): the only app-key reader of `branding.logo` in app-shell / layout / console is `AppSidebar.tsx:218` (unmounted); `plugin-form/EmbeddableForm.tsx:530` reads a form embed config and `runtime-config.ts:403` reads `branding.logoUrl` — neither is the app key. At `fb91ac9b0` there is no reader at all. Producers exist at both shas: `plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx#AppCreationWizard` (700; writes `logo` at 604–605), `BrandingEditor.tsx#BrandingEditor` (105; writes at 308–309, previews at 476/560), `pages/EditAppPage.tsx#EditAppPage` (19; pre-fills at 52). `packages/types/src/app.ts#wizardDraftToAppSchema` (16 in the extracted range) copies `draft.branding.logo` to a top-level `logo`, and `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx#InternalSidebar` renders `schema.logo` (384–398) — the row states this nuance correctly. objectui#10827 is open, `domain:ui`, `priority:p2`, and names itself the carrier for `app.branding.logo`.

Status under the README: `planned` = "Declared, intentionally not enforced yet"; `dead` = no consumer anywhere the census looked, tracked for enforce-or-remove; `live` needs a runtime consumer. The key is authored, has a named carrier building its renderer, and triage (`5832699195`) directed ENFORCE, so `planned` is the fitting status, `dead` would contradict the triage direction and `live` has no reader. The gate scans `planned` rows' `evidence` when present and `producer` at any status (`EVIDENCE_SCANNED_STATUSES` includes `planned`; `producer` resolves through the same resolver, foreign paths counted not resolved); no rule requires `evidence` on a `planned` row, and the row's `producer` is the correct field for the authoring side. `authorWarn`: README "Author warnings" rule 1 bars marking benign display metadata (`description`, `tags`, `icon` are its examples); `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts#shouldWarn` (157–159) warns only on `authorWarn === true` or `status === 'experimental'`, so a `planned` row without the flag produces no author-facing change, matching the `field.useGrouping` precedent (`planned`, no `authorWarn`, no evidence/producer). Dropping `authorWarn` is correct.

**3. No row lost a reader; no row became `live` without one; gate green; `state-counts.md` current; baseline deletion exact — RIGHT.**

Structural walk of `app.json` at `1207baf0` vs the head: 16 rows changed. 11 leaf rows `live` → `live` with evidence changed (`label`, `description`, `icon`, `active`, `hidden`, `navigation.id`, `navigation.visible`, `areas.id`, `areas.label`, `areas.icon`, `areas.navigation`); `branding` went from one `live` leaf to a drilled container with `primaryColor` / `accentColor` / `favicon` `live` and `logo` `planned`. Leaf counts 39 live + 9 dead → 41 live + 1 planned + 9 dead. No status went `live` → anything else; every `live` row at the head carries evidence; no `AppSidebar` remains in any `evidence` or `producer` field; no `authorWarn` changed. Rows still citing `@940ba24` (24 legs) never named `AppSidebar` and are unchanged.

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` at the head: exit 0; `app 59 classified (live 49, dead 9, planned 1)`; `evidence paths: 614 repo-local … 614 resolved … 218 attributed to another repo`; `symbol anchors: 758 … 758`; `container coverage: 109 … 565 child key(s)`; `✓ packages/spec/liveness/state-counts.md is current — the same 40 row(s)`. Control at the base ledger files (`1207baf0`): exit 0, `app 56 classified (live 47, dead 9)`, 202 foreign, 110 / 569. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:liveness-counts` at the head rewrote `state-counts.md` byte-identically (`git diff` empty); the diff's `app` row `47/0/0/9/0/56` → `49/0/0/9/1/59` and totals `931/5/1/168/11/1116` → `933/5/1/168/12/1119` are what the gate measures.

Baseline: `drill.mts` fails a baseline row whose container now drills. Control: with `app/branding` put back into `undrilled-containers.baseline.json` at the head, the gate exits 1 with `✗ 1 stale undrilled-container row(s) — the gap is already closed: app/branding`. The one-row deletion is exactly what the drill requires, and it is a shrink of a shrink-only file.

**4. `app.zod.ts` diff is comments only; the new prose is true at the pin — RIGHT.**

`typescript.transpileModule` with `removeComments` on the base and head files gives identical output (33276 bytes both); the raw diff is six lines, all inside two JSDoc blocks; counts of `describe(`, `strictObject(` and `retiredKey(` are unchanged; `strict-object.ts` is identical to `origin/main`. Prose: `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx#resolveHref` (561) calls `applyNavTemplate` (487, substituting `current_user_id` / `current_org_id` at 495–496) at 575, 596, 629, 677; `UnifiedSidebar` supplies `templateContext={{ currentUserId, currentOrgId, contextValues }}` (558, 684); app-shell `console/AppContent.tsx` imports `resolveHref` (38) and its landing route goes `resolveLandingRoute` (1259) → `findFirstRoute` (1211) → `buildItemRoute` (1233) → `resolveHref(item, '', ctx)` (1236). `AREA_ORDER_RETIRED` prose: `UnifiedSidebar` does `areas.filter(...)` (272) with no `.sort(` anywhere in the file, and `AppSchemaRenderer` does `areas.filter` (545) / `areas.map` (230) as authored. Both true at the pin and at `fb91ac9b0`.

**5. Semver / changeset — RIGHT.** See ②.

**6. Top-level app `logo`: "folds into branding" (order) vs refused (dev) — the dev is RIGHT; the order's word is WRONG on `main`.**

`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1387` has `logo: 'branding'` in the app-level alias table; `strict-object.ts` uses `aliases` only to phrase the `unrecognized_keys` refusal (`aliases[aliasProbe(key)] ?? findClosestMatches(…)`, and `markUnknownKeyRefusalTerminal` makes the refusal terminal); nothing rewrites the key. Probe run with `tsx` at the head, which is equivalent to `main` for this behaviour (`app.zod.ts` differs from `origin/main` by the six comment lines only and `strict-object.ts` is identical): `AppSchema.safeParse({ name: 'probe_app', label: 'Probe', logo: 'https://x/l.png' })` → `success: false`, one issue `unrecognized_keys`, path `[]`, keys `['logo']`, message "Unrecognized key(s) on this app: `logo`. Did you mean `logo` → `branding`? …"; `{ …, branding: { logo } }` → `success: true` with `branding.logo` kept; both spellings together → refused on `logo`. `AppSchema` declares one spelling (`branding.logo`, `app.zod.ts:927`); the order's conclusion (nothing to retire) stands.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec` (`.changeset/20146-app-ledger-repoint.md`) is right. `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` is `["dist","json-schema","liveness","prompts","llms.txt","README.md","src/**/*.zod.ts",…]`, so both `liveness/app.json` and the `app.zod.ts` comment change publish; `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` reads the shipped `liveness/` directory with `readFileSync` (72–133) to decide advisory warnings, so the ledger is consumed data, not internal tooling. Nothing in the parsed surface, refusal text, `.describe()` or accept set moves (probe and transpile compare above), so no minor or major is owed and `skip-changeset` would have been false. The changeset's statements were checked: `files[]` includes `liveness` (true), lint reads the ledgers for author warnings (true), `app` 56 → 59 classified with one `planned` (true, measured), `branding` drilled and its baseline row removed (true), `description` narrower but `live` (true), the `active` note and the two `app.zod.ts` mentions corrected (true). `Clause-②: no` is consistent with all of it. `check-changeset-no-major` has nothing to object to.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Cross-repo evidence: all 12 re-pointed rows cite `objectui @f8a9d0fb`, the `.objectui-sha` pin at the head, with `evidenceScope: cross-repo` and `verifiedAt: 2026-09-27`; each read was controlled at objectui `fb91ac9b0` (post-removal) and answers identically, so the next pin bump does not strand them.
- Carrier: objectui#10827 (open, `domain:ui`, p2) is named on the `branding.logo` row; its own "folds into branding" wording is imprecise and is the seat's to correct there, not this PR's.
- Registered-not-mounted leg: `NavMenuRenderer` (see ① nuance); non-blocking because every row citing it also cites a mounted reader.
- Out of scope, noted by the dev and confirmed: stale `rest-server.ts:1870` / `:1837` pointers inside `note` prose on `areas.navigation` / `navigation.children` (not scanned by any gate); the unchanged `@940ba24` legs.
- Deviation from the claim's file surface (`undrilled-containers.baseline.json` row deleted; changeset added): both are mechanical consequences the order anticipated ("whether a changeset is owed is decided by the gates") and are measured above.
- CI at the head at review time: 39 check runs — 32 success, 6 skipped, 0 failed, 1 still in progress (`Lint & Repo Gates`). Readiness stays gated on every context finishing green, per the seat's ACCEPT.
